  "description": "# Squares in Squares — validated public portfolio\n\n## Current release\nThis public version contains the exact 1,000-puzzle / 500,500-row portfolio submitted as Kaggle receipt **57898267**, which completed at **22.2570060169**. The serialized `submission.csv` SHA-256 is `373af2ea4343866d8865c00f44bf8e6746451447260ebc8b243f9d899c9408fe`; the reviewed official metric SHA-256 is `d269f24b02d5f33fbd2149f76b83414b3b446be4d02776560e04631af3365ccf`.\n\n## Files and use\n- `submission.csv`: exact complete coordinates. Replace whole `n` groups atomically; never mix rows from different layouts.\n- `per_puzzle.csv`: enclosing length, normalized score, and current source for every puzzle.\n- `per_puzzle_contributors.csv`: provider and inherited lineage; provider is not automatically original discoverer or author.\n- `contribution_leaderboard.csv`: evidence-based numerical adoption summary, not effort shares or team membership.\n- `dashboard.html`: self-contained local dashboard. If a notebook link or embedded preview is unavailable, download this file and open it directly in a browser. In a Kaggle notebook session, it is also available from the **Output** tab as `dashboard.html`.\n\n## Contributor correction\nThe current dashboard includes Jazivxt (`jazivxt/boxed-in-sub`) at verified rank 9 with 43 currently retained puzzles and `0.002121709552763486` in independently certified completed components. This records numerical provider lineage only; the notebook disclosed no generation method, and no team, coauthor, or exclusive-discovery claim is made.\n\n## Validation and provenance\nAll 1,000 whole-puzzle groups passed the current official RAW evaluator. Exact hashes, current receipt binding, source-specific notices, and the five-output dashboard verification are retained. Historical aggregate Kaggle reductions remain unallocated where person-level attribution is not evidenced. Review `SOURCE_NOTICES.md` and the license files before redistribution.\n\n## Dashboard link\nOwner notebook: https://www.kaggle.com/code/kmmmvs/squares-dashboard-public-batch-20261027 . It uses a private serving dataset, so access or rendered links may not work for every viewer. The authoritative public fallback is the included `dashboard.html` file described above.\n",
